environment.description: Deployed behind an Istio service mesh with PeerAuthentication policy set to STRICT mode on the namespace. The Istio ingress gateway has an EnvoyFilter resource that performs client certificate validation against an internal CA (acme-tenant-ca). A custom AuthorizationPolicy with a CUSTOM action delegates to an OPA sidecar that extracts the SPIFFE identity from the validated peer certificate (spiffe://acme.internal/ns/{namespace}/sa/{service-account}) and cross-references it against a tenant-to-invoice-range mapping stored in a ConfigMap mounted at /etc/opa/tenant-bindings.json. The OPA policy (package acme.authz) returns allow only when the requested invoice ID falls within the numeric range assigned to the SPIFFE identity's mapped tenant. Additionally, the X-Client-Cert-DN header is overwritten by Envoy's downstream TLS metadata (not passthrough from client), preventing header spoofing.
